summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of TS Unique Laundry portal via public URL. Home, all 7 top-nav pages, 12 service cards & detail routing, pricing calculator interactivity (type change R360->R520, express toggle -> R840), subscriptions plan-comparison-table + 5 plan cards, Zod contact form validation + success toast, MOCK auth (customer & admin), forgot-password success state, protected routes redirect, dashboard/admin sub-pages, recharts rendering, referral copy, profile save, logout, and custom 404 all verified working. No console/page errors captured.

ui_bugs.issue: Auth state stored only in useState (no localStorage/sessionStorage). Any page reload or direct URL navigation to /dashboard, /dashboard/history, /admin, etc. kicks the logged-in user back to /login. Repro: login -> land on /dashboard -> press F5 -> redirected to /login. Fix: persist user object in localStorage in AuthContext and rehydrate on mount.
Success toast appears duplicated (identical message rendered twice) after valid submit.

action_items: Persist mock auth session in localStorage inside AuthContext so refresh/deep-link doesn't dump users to /login.
De-duplicate the contact-form success toast (likely double sonner call or double submit handler).
critical_code_review_comments: AuthContext lacks persistence; even for mock auth, a portal must survive reloads.
Cross-role guard not testable via reload path due to above; effectively any deep-link (/admin/orders) as customer just redirects to /login rather than a 403 or /dashboard.
test_credentials: Customer: naledi@example.co.za / password123 ; Admin: admin@ts.co.za / password123 (any email; 'admin' substring => admin role).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids in review request exist and work. Use SPA navigation (click sidebar links) rather than page.goto() when testing dashboard/admin sub-pages — because AuthContext is not persisted, hard navigations lose the session and redirect to /login. Once persistence is fixed, retest reload/deep-link behavior. 404 page shows correctly on unknown routes.
rca of the issue: AuthContext.jsx uses `const [user, setUser] = useState(null)` with no localStorage read/write. React state is per-page-load, so a full document load (reload or address-bar navigation) resets user to null, RequireAuth sees no user and Navigate replaces to /login.
